results.title: Oxi-Tech and Warwick develop electrochemical water treatment
results.description: Oxi-Tech and Warwick will develop industrial electrochemical water disinfection systems. Their Innovate UK-backed partnership will investigate ozone-generation efficiency, electrode life, manufacturing cost and electrical monitoring for water treatment and clean-in-place equipment. The post Oxi-Tech and Warwick develop electrochemical water treatment appeared first on Industrial News.
